facts.fact: The compendium calls South Africa's MyMzansi a 'Cabinet-approved Digital Transformation Roadmap launched in 2024', anchored in the Presidency; it describes the scope only as a national DPI programme on four pillars (digital identity, data exchange, payments, digital services), so the class is left empty.
facts.system: Roadmap for the Digital Transformation of Government

systems.owner: Presidency; Digital Services Unit delivers day to day, Inter-Ministerial Committee gives political oversight, Interdepartmental Working Group chaired by Directors-General of the Presidency, National Treasury and DCDT

note: Fact recorded with class empty: the document names the roadmap and gives its pillars and governance but does not say whether it covers the economy as well as the state; the parent should classify it against docs 4 and 7, which treat it as a government roadmap. The launch year (2024) differs from other documents' Cabinet approval date.
